name: Question 5
problem:
A dye vat initially holds $450\,\text{L}$ of liquid containing $2\,\text{kg}$ of dissolved dye.
A solution containing $0.02\,\text{kg/L}$ of dissolved dye is pumped into the vat at a rate of $30\,\text{L/min},$ while the completely mixed liquid is drained out at a rate of $30\,\text{L/min}.$ Which expression gives the amount of dye $Q(t),$ in kilograms, in the vat $t$ minutes after pumping begins?

Question 5
?

A dye vat initially holds 450L of liquid containing 2kg of dissolved dye. A solution containing 0.02kg/L of dissolved dye is pumped into the vat at a rate of 30L/min, while the completely mixed liquid is drained out at a rate of 30L/min. Which expression gives the amount of dye Q(t), in kilograms, in the vat t minutes after pumping begins?

a
Q(t)=9−7e−t/15
b
Q(t)=9+7e−t/15
c
Q(t)=9−7e−t/20
d
Q(t)=2−9e−t/15
e
Q(t)=9−7et/15
